cape.rule: At a bus in run_input_flags.cape_5yr the 2028 Base is PCR 2030 as it is, where held (studio/PRICE-BASIS.md).

body.method: Proxy scenario = Base × factor (D-002): High Gas × 1.10, Low Gas × 0.90, High Load × 1.20. Base is the run the Studio price basis reads each year — 2028 the 5yr run (PCR 2030 at a Cape-flagged bus, studio/PRICE-BASIS.md), 2030/2035/2040 the PCR runs, 2045/2050 PCR 2040 × cathy.meta.vendor_step per five years. LMP, energy, congestion and loss all scale by the same factor, so LMP = energy + congestion + loss stays exact (components on the settled sign, tools/lmp_components.py). Hourly shapes scale uniformly: every hour × the factor. Revenue, capture and spreads are computed downstream from the scaled prices — so a capture RATIO is unchanged by a proxy while $/MWh capture prices and spreads scale by the factor. Settled history is never scaled: proxies apply to solved and escalated years only.
body.notice: High Gas, Low Gas and High Load are proxies (illustrative proxy — not a PROBE run): Base × a fixed factor, not a solved market outcome. They exist to build and check the scenario workflow until PROBE runs land.
